build_habitat_sim_config: build a Habitat-Sim simulator configuration with scene, physics, and sensor settings using make_cfg
create_sensor_specs: create sensor specifications with uuid, type, resolution, and position from SIM config
create_agent_action_space: create an agent action space with move_forward, turn_left, and turn_right actions
review_make_cfg: review the make_cfg function that builds SimulatorConfiguration with sensors and agent specs
refactor_make_cfg: refactor make_cfg to move hardcoded agent actions and gpu2gpu_transfer into the SIM config
